#include <iostream>
#define MOD 1000000007LL
using namespace std;

long long power(long long base, long long exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    long long half = power(base, exp / 2);
    long long result = (half * half) % MOD;
    if (exp % 2 == 1) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << power(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << power(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long q = k;
    int cycle_len = 1;
    while (q != 1) {
        q = (q * k) % p;
        cycle_len++;
    }
    
    cout << power(p, (p - 1) / cycle_len);
    return 0;
}

long long fastPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    vector<long long> memo(exp + 1, -1);
    function<long long(long long)> dp = [&](long long e) -> long long {
        if (e == 0) return 1;
        if (e == 1) return base % MOD;
        if (memo[e] != -1) return memo[e];
        long long half = dp(e / 2);
        long long res = (half * half) % MOD;
        if (e % 2) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        return memo[e] = res;
    };
    return dp(exp);
}

        q = (q * k) % p;
        n++;

#include <iostream>

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

long long binpow(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    a %= MOD;
    for (; b; b >>= 1, a = a * a % MOD)
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << binpow(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }

        cout << binpow(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    
    long long cur = k % p;
    int order = 1;
    while (cur != 1) {
        cur = cur * k % p;
        ++order;
    }
    
    cout << binpow(p, (p - 1) / order);
    return 0;
}
